title: CompressedProgrammeRisk
description: Contract for Brain Migration Slice 3 — Stage 1 compressed-programme risk rule. Contract version 1.0.0 (same overall JSON Schema contract convention as door-size-default.schema.json/heated-building-risk.schema.json; no breaking change, so no contract-version bump). Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain. Any copy elsewhere (e.g. vendored into the application repository) is a mechanically identical mirror, never independently edited.

ProgrammeInput.description: The raw Stage 1 'programme' answer. Only the exact string '0–3 months' (en dash, U+2013) triggers a risk — comparison is case-sensitive exact match. Any other string (the four other fixed options '3–6 months'/'6–12 months'/'12+ months'/'Not decided', an empty string, null, undefined, or an unrecognised/legacy value) is valid input and must produce a null output.

RiskOutput.description: The risk this rule contributes to p.risks1, or null when the rule does not fire.

text.const: The requested programme is compressed relative to the approvals, design, civils, manufacture and installation stages that may still be required.
